scope: round-3 first-principles system design under fully relaxed internal constraints (product output = Jev-style decision without U); zero-GPU research
axioms: multiplication tax: pipeline accuracy ~ p^k (p = per-predicate grounding accuracy, k = predicate chain length); beat 94.2 at k=3 needs p~0.98 -> minimize k, maximize p, prefer arbitration over chaining
heterogeneous dividend: neural residuals (relational/existential/temporal) are symbolic strengths and vice versa -> neural x symbolic arbitration has additive tax, unlike same-backbone ensembles
free supervision: training-pool program truth is offline-executable -> per-predicate supervision for the extractor AND full offline scoring of any pipeline before product commitment
externalized solving: 96-99 tier exists only when the LM leaves the solving loop; redefine 'decide' as formalize (fallible, measurable, distillable) + execute (deterministic)

paradigms.name: Formalizer-Executor (FX)
paradigms.one_liner: Small model (or teacher-distilled candidate) formalizes question+media into a program over the frozen program grammar plus bindings; a deterministic executor solves it; output is the Jev-style decision.
paradigms.first_principles: externalized solving sets the ceiling to grounding quality, which has free supervision and is offline-measurable before any product bet; every stage scoreable
paradigms.p_beat_942: 0.55-0.7 as combination (FX alone ~88-93 on natural video due to p^k tax; FX+QCE+CES+HXA targets 94-97)
paradigms.workdays: 2-4 (executor+grammar 1-2d from B1 lattice and symbolic-tier code; prompted formalizer 1d; distilled formalizer +2d)
paradigms.shortest_integration: B1 program lattice as grammar; training-pool program truth as extractor supervision and eval set; reuse measured 96-99 symbolic execution path
paradigms.pilot_48h: zero-training: teacher 27B few-shot as formalizer on 200-500 dev video questions -> execute -> score; per-predicate extraction F1 on train slice; gates: >=92 -> distill; 85-92 -> add N3/N2; <85 -> grounding wall, pivot to N2/N7
failure_modes: grammar coverage of natural-language long-tail (fallback to neural direct)
distilled formalizer degrading -> fix with N6

nearest_neighbors.name: ViperGPT
nearest_neighbors.difference: arbitrary Python over vision APIs, no frozen grammar, no program-truth supervision, no decision-shaped output

nearest_neighbors.name: VisProg
nearest_neighbors.difference: same lineage, GPT-4 based, no free per-predicate truth

nearest_neighbors.name: self-training visual program synthesis (CVPR 2024)
nearest_neighbors.difference: trains program synthesis without per-predicate ground truth

paradigms.name: Heterogeneous Arbitration (HXA)
paradigms.one_liner: Run teacher-distilled neural direct answer and the N1 symbolic pipeline in parallel; agreement passes through; disagreement goes to a lightweight arbitrator (trace-consistency rules, escalating to teacher-as-judge over the execution trace, not the bare answer).
paradigms.first_principles: disjoint error sources give an ensemble dividend same-backbone ensembles provably lack (measured); arbitration pays additive tax, not p^k
paradigms.p_beat_942: 0.6-0.75 conditional on pipeline >=85; with pipeline 90, neural 94.2, 70% arbitration win on disagreements -> ~96
paradigms.shortest_integration: cached teacher-direct outputs already exist; pipeline outputs from N1 pilot; rule arbitrator first (physical/trace consistency)
paradigms.pilot_48h: offline confusion matrix + arbitration simulation from N1 outputs vs cached direct answers; gates: separability AUC>0.7 on disagreement set AND simulated total >94.2
failure_modes: both paths wrong on the same items (correlated failures kill the dividend - measurable, abandon if >30%)
arbitration latency -> escalate only on high percentile

nearest_neighbors.name: Symbolic Verification for Best-of-K
nearest_neighbors.difference: selects among same-source sampled candidates, not heterogeneous neural-vs-symbolic paths

paradigms.name: Question-Conditioned Extraction (QCE)
paradigms.one_liner: Do not extract a full scene symbol set; parse the program first and extract bindings only for the entities/time windows the program touches, iterating if execution starves.
paradigms.first_principles: k-minimization is the only lever that pulls p^k back above 94.2 (k from 3-4 to 1-2 lowers the required p from ~0.98 to ~0.97 with CES checks on top)
paradigms.p_beat_942: core lever on N1: typical extraction F1 +3-8pt; chain length -40%
paradigms.shortest_integration: program parse from N1; extraction supervision from training-pool truth
paradigms.pilot_48h: two arms (full schema vs question-conditioned) on 200 train videos with known truth; gate: effective chain length -40% with no F1 drop
failure_modes: program misparse steers extraction (needs N1 parse accuracy first)

nearest_neighbors.name: active perception line (navigation, Act2See CVPR 2026)
nearest_neighbors.difference: navigation/frame selection, not predicate extraction; retrieval found no direct precedent for question-conditioned predicate extraction

paradigms.name: Counterfactual Execution Self-check (CES)
paradigms.one_liner: The executor minimally perturbs extracted symbols (drop an event, swap a binding); if the answer does not change when it should or changes when it should not, grounding is flagged suspect -> re-extract or downweight; the executor acts as its own critic.
paradigms.first_principles: a deterministic executor makes the answer's functional dependence on symbols explicitly enumerable -> zero-model consistency verification unique to the symbolic path
paradigms.p_beat_942: mainly supplies arbitration features and an N1 safety net
paradigms.shortest_integration: executor from N1; perturbation set over grammar predicates
paradigms.pilot_48h: inject perturbations into known-wrong extractions; gate: >60% detection, <20% false positives

paradigms.name: Pre-executed Answer Memory (PAM)
paradigms.one_liner: Offline-execute every training-pool program against its ground-truth world state into a symbolic answer bank keyed by program skeleton + binding slots; online retrieval instantiates the skeleton with perceived bindings: decide = table lookup + local correction.
paradigms.first_principles: benchmark questions come from a finite program grammar -> the reasoning component compresses into zero-error infrastructure; only binding remains perceptual
paradigms.p_beat_942: accelerator/fallback role; viable only if skeleton retrieval@1 >=85%
paradigms.shortest_integration: training-pool programs + truth; retrieval keys reuse 002-II4 program-key design
paradigms.pilot_48h: pure CPU: skeleton retrieval accuracy and binding alignment rate on training pool
failure_modes: zero generalization to out-of-grammar questions (must coexist with N1 executor)

nearest_neighbors.name: kNN-Prompt / RETRO lineage
nearest_neighbors.difference: label-distribution retrieval, not program lookup + binding instantiation (no direct precedent found)

paradigms.name: Belief-Marginal Execution (BB)
paradigms.one_liner: Keep top-m candidates for uncertain binding slots; enumerate m^u combinations, execute all, and marginalize (or take the mode) over binding priors: test-time marginalization at the symbol layer instead of the readout layer.
paradigms.first_principles: the executor is cheap and deterministic -> enumeration beats sampling variance; uncertainty is modeled at the correct layer (bindings), not the readout
paradigms.pilot_48h: argmax-binding vs top-3 marginalization on 200 dev items (requires N1 running)
failure_modes: binding prior bias (calibrate with extraction logits)

nearest_neighbors.name: self-consistency lineage
nearest_neighbors.difference: marginalizes sampled answers; ours marginalizes symbolic bindings (no direct precedent found)

paradigms.name: Executor-in-the-Loop Training (ELT)
paradigms.one_liner: Train the extractor with the executor's final-answer correctness as the reward (sampling through the non-differentiable executor; group = multiple extractions of the same item), with program-truth F1 as auxiliary.
paradigms.first_principles: align extraction with the answer, not the F1: some symbol errors do not change the answer, and only key predicates matter (dual of the p^k axiom)
paradigms.shortest_integration: generalizes in-flight GRPO-on-lattice (group = question lattice -> group = extraction samples); executor as environment
paradigms.pilot_48h: zero-GPU decisiveness test: offline decorrelation analysis between F1 deltas and answer-correctness deltas on training pool (larger decorrelation -> larger ELT value)

nearest_neighbors.name: GRPO-on-lattice (in-flight, ours)
nearest_neighbors.difference: special case; ELT generalizes the group structure to extraction samples

paradigms.name: Synthesis Engine Amplifier (SEA)
paradigms.one_liner: Round-2 closed-loop and twin-track synthesis repositioned as the data amplifier for N1/N2: unlimited (video, program, truth) triples to distill the extractor.
paradigms.first_principles: the formalizer needs per-predicate truth, exactly what the synthesis engine emits for free; sim-to-real grounding transfer is the only risk, controllable by real-pool mixing ratio
paradigms.pilot_48h: small-scale extractor distillation on synthetic data -> real train-slice F1 (needs some GPU; otherwise in-domain F1 + distribution-shift report as go/no-go input)

paradigms.name: Trace-Distillation Back-pressure (TDB)
paradigms.one_liner: Once N1+N3 run, distill the pipeline's answers (option distributions with execution traces) back into the compact candidate: the product keeps the small-direct-model story while the pipeline becomes a verifiable teacher factory.
paradigms.first_principles: the pipeline upgrades the 94.2 teacher into a >94.2 teacher with verifiable traces, lifting the 001-I5 ceiling

paradigms.name: Difficulty Cascade (DC)
paradigms.one_liner: Route by predicted difficulty: easy items answer directly (low latency), hard items escalate to the FX pipeline, disagreements to arbitration; average latency stays within the product line.
paradigms.first_principles: the 96-99 tier need not trigger on every item - escalate only on the low-confidence percentile, decoupling cost from accuracy
paradigms.shortest_integration: cached confidence distributions; N1's uncertain-slot count as a difficulty signal
paradigms.pilot_48h: zero-GPU: escalation-rate/accuracy curves from cached confidences

why: the only measured tier above teacher 94.2 is the symbolic tier with the LM out of the solving loop (96-99): put solving there and demote the LM to formalizer

every component (formalization accuracy, per-predicate grounding F1, execution correctness) is offline-scoreable against training-pool truth before any product commitment: the only 'decidably winnable' route
the p^k tax is explicit and QCE/CES/BB/HXA are direct hedges on it: a design equation, not a bag of tricks
48h zero-training go/no-go: smallest risk exposure; N3/N2/N4/N8 all compound on it

abort_switches: 48h pilot: teacher-as-formalizer pipeline <85 AND per-predicate F1 <0.9 -> grounding wall; demote symbolic route to N3 dispatcher, pivot to N7 or neural line (001-I5/I6)
disagreement set both-wrong rate >30% -> HXA dividend falsified
grammar coverage of the target bench low -> N1 capped at in-grammar subset; report coverage in the pilot
evidence_notes: Nearest-neighbor anchoring searched this round: ViperGPT/VisProg/self-training program synthesis (LLM-as-programmer skeleton has precedent; N1's delta = frozen grammar + free program-truth supervision + decision output), question-conditioned predicate extraction (zero direct hit), symbolic self-verification (Best-of-K symbolic verification + counterfactual-consistency prompting as neighbors).
PAM and BB not individually searched; component precedents (kNN lineage, self-consistency lineage) honestly attributed as combinatorial novelty.
